title: Apple China App Store adds AIGC compliance filing fields
summary: Apple has added two mandatory compliance fields to App Store Connect for apps distributed in mainland China: an AIGC service declaration with filing information, and a security assessment proof. New apps must submit them immediately, while existing apps have until January 31, 2027. The requirements cover apps providing AIGC features such as chatbots, image or video generation, and voice or face editing; apps using third-party technology must also upload an authorization agreement and the algorithm filing number. Apple’s 2026 review guidelines already include generative-AI provisions.
